data.title: Multiple Unrelated Customers Depositing to Same Novel Beneficiary — Investment Club Pattern
data.description: Detects investment club scam patterns where multiple unrelated victims deposit funds to the same fraudulent beneficiary within a short time window. FBI IC3 2025 documented approximately 1,600 investment club complaints with $160 million in losses, and PSA250703 specifically warned about fraudulent investment clubs on social media and messaging apps. The cluster deposit pattern — five or more unique, unrelated customers sending to the same novel beneficiary within 14 days — distinguishes investment club scams from 1:1 pig butchering (TP-0017) where victims typically deposit to unique beneficiary accounts. The group-based nature creates a detectable convergence signal absent from individual targeting schemes.

enrichment_required.source: Count of unique customer IDs sending to the same beneficiary within trailing 14 days
Boolean — whether any of the depositing customers have prior payment relationships with each other
Days since the beneficiary first received any payment across the institution

queries.cql:
// CrowdStrike CQL for Investment Club Group Deposit Clustering
// Detects multiple unrelated customers depositing to same novel beneficiary
(transaction_type="wire_transfer" OR transaction_type="ach_credit" OR transaction_type="crypto_purchase" OR transaction_type="faster_payment")
beneficiary_first_seen_days<=90
| groupBy(beneficiary_id, function=[
    collect([customer_id, transaction_amount, transaction_date, payment_reference]),
    count(distinct=customer_id, as=unique_depositors),
    sum(transaction_amount, as=total_cluster_amount),
    count(transaction_id, as=total_transactions)
  ])
| unique_depositors >= 5
| sort(total_cluster_amount, order=desc)
queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Investment Club Group Deposit Clustering")`
`comment("Detects multiple unrelated customers depositing to same novel beneficiary within 14 days")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:transaction_monitoring
  (transaction_type="wire_transfer" OR transaction_type="ach_credit"
   OR transaction_type="crypto_purchase" OR transaction_type="faster_payment")
  beneficiary_first_seen_days<=90
| bin _time span=14d
| stats dc(customer_id) AS unique_depositors, count AS total_transactions,
    sum(transaction_amount) AS total_cluster_amount,
    values(customer_id) AS depositor_list,
    values(payment_reference) AS references,
    avg(transaction_amount) AS avg_deposit
    by beneficiary_id, beneficiary_name, _time
| where unique_depositors >= 5
| eval risk_score = case(
    unique_depositors >= 10 AND total_cluster_amount > 500000, "critical",
    unique_depositors >= 5 AND total_cluster_amount > 100000, "high",
    1=1, "medium")
| sort - total_cluster_amount

references: FBI IC3, 2025 Internet Crime Report — Investment club scams: ~1,600 complaints, $160M losses
FBI IC3 PSA250703, July 3, 2025 — Fraudsters Target US Stock Investors through Investment Clubs
falsepositives: Legitimate crowdfunding or group investment platforms receiving deposits from multiple customers
Business accounts receiving payments from multiple clients
Charity or event organizers receiving donations from multiple individuals
